facts.business: Himalaya Food International Ltd is engaged in food processing operations, using agro waste to fire boilers at its plants in Paonta Sahib (Himachal Pradesh) and Mehsana (Gujarat).
key_risks: Bank accounts classified as NPA since March 2018
Ongoing OTS settlement with banks (Rs 9,290 lakhs total, Rs 7,654 lakhs paid till 31.03.2026)
Contingent liabilities of Rs 7,560 lakhs including DGFT matter (Rs 3,277 lakhs), Income tax appeal (Rs 762 lakhs), GST matter (Rs 550 lakhs)
Revenue recognition risk due to critical estimates in fixed price contracts
Resignation of statutory auditors during the year
facts.related_party_note: Loans and advances from Managing Director Mr MM Malik (Rs 289 lakhs in 2025) and Wholetime Director Mrs Sangita Malik; personal guarantees of directors and promoters for term loans and working capital limits; transactions with related parties disclosed in financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
